manifest.name: dsh-media-desk
manifest.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件。一句话记灵感，一键成稿：口播脚本、标题、视频封面、配图和黑白线稿分镜。

bundle.text:
# dsh-media-desk bundle patch：同一个包提供 host 半片与浏览器半片
- insert:
    - id: media-desk
      name: 'dsh-media-desk'

readme.text:
自媒体工作台

DeepSeek Harness 的一个插件。记一句灵感，一键做出脚本、封面、配图和分镜。

由小红书科技博主 蜗牛的科技笔记 开发，一个每天要发内容的人，给自己做的工作台。
安装 · 要花钱吗 · 问答 · English

装在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 侧栏里的一个页面。打开是一面灵感墙，一句话记一个灵感；点开任何一条，一键生成口播脚本、标题、视频封面、配图和黑白线稿分镜；左边聊一句，右边就改。做好的稿子拖到日历上排期，发布之后回来看数据。 五个页面：**灵感 · 内容 · 排期 · 复盘 · 风格**。界面有中文和英文，默认跟随 DeepSeek Harness 的语言，也可以在插件设置里固定；切到英文后，脚本、标题和分镜也用英文写。网页版在手机浏览器里也能打开。 除了小红书、抖音、B 站、公众号，也支持 TikTok、Instagram、YouTube 和 X，发海外也能用。

整页一起长出来。

点开灵感，稿面的格子一开始就排好了。标题、脚本、视频封面、配图和六格分镜同时生成，一边生成一边填满。

说一句，就改。

「表达再直接一点」「第 3 镜换成俯拍」「封面字更有冲击力」，右边实时更新，每一步都能撤销。

拿走就能用。

脚本直接编辑、一键复制；或者连封面、配图和分镜图一起，保存成一个文件夹。

一句话，一个灵感。

文字、链接、图片、视频、金句，贴进来就是一张卡片。散落在无限画布上，或者切成按时间排的信息流。

相关的灵感自己凑过来。

在中间输入「agent」回车，新灵感记下的同时，以前提到 agent 的灵感会按相关程度挪到它旁边，一眼看全。

右边有个助手。

「把今天最好的灵感一键成稿」「接下来有什么排期」「以后标题都不要超过 20 个字」，一句话就办。

一张日历，两件事。

每天一张灵感邮票，记录你的连续天数；做好的稿子从右边拖到某一天，就排好了。

右上角永远是下一条要发的。

数据进来，规则出去。

手动录入、粘贴 CSV，或者导入你自己的账号。趋势、平台分布、表现最好的内容，一眼看完。

从数据里提炼出来的建议，点一下就写进写作规则，以后每篇都遵守。规则还能导出成 DeepSeek Harness 的 Skill。

按谁的风格写，你定。

科技数码、旅行探店、Vlog 生活、观点认知、干货教程、种草测评、情感故事、热点资讯，8 个板块 15 种博主预设，选一种就能开写。

也可以是你自己的。

导入自己的账号，或者贴几篇写过的稿子，提炼成专属风格卡，随时改。

内容页把所有稿子按灵感、成稿、待发布、已发布排好。

要求 DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` 及以上的 `0.2.x`，已在 `0.2.2-rc.1` 的桌面版和网页版上测过。

**1. 安装。** 打开 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版，进「插件」→「添加插件」，输入包名 `dsh-media-desk`，点安装。

也可以用命令行。桌面版要先完全退出（⌘Q）再装，装好重新打开；网页版装好后重启 `dsh web`。终端里没有 `dsh` 的话，先在桌面版菜单里选「管理 dsh 命令」。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-media-desk
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-media-desk
```

**2. 更新。** 有新版本时，在插件页点更新，或者重新执行一次上面的命令。想离线安装的话，也可以到 [Releases](https://github.com/woniuniuniu/dsh-media-desk/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-media-desk-*.tgz`，把包名换成 `"file:$PWD/dsh-media-desk-版本号.tgz"`。 **3. 打开。** 侧栏会出现「自媒体工作台」。第一次看到的都是示例数据，方便你先看看每个页面长什么样；点右上角「示例数据 · 清空」，换成自己的。 卸载时把 `add` 换成 `remove dsh-media-desk`。你的内容一直在 `~/.dsh/media-desk/`，不会跟着删。

插件本身免费开源，不带任何密钥。用到模型的地方，走你自己的账号。 | | 用什么 | 不接会怎样 | | --- | --- | --- | | **写脚本** | DeepSeek Harness 里你已经配好的模型 | 只能出结构草稿 | | **画封面、配图、分镜** | 你自己的生图 API Key，在插件设置里填 | 脚本和分镜文案照常，封面变成纯文字版 | | **导入自己的账号**（可选） | 第三方服务 Monid，按次计费：小红书一个账号约 0.02 美元（一毛多），抖音、B 站、TikTok、Instagram、X 不到 1 美分 | 手动录数据，或贴内容提炼风格 | 生图支持任何兼容 OpenAI 图片接口（`POST {接口地址}/images/generations`）的服务，设置里预填了 OpenAI、xAI、火山方舟、智谱、硅基流动，也可以自定义。填好点「试画一张」就知道通没通。一次成稿默认 9 张图，数量可调。密钥只存在本机的 `settings.json`，权限 600，不进内容数据，也不会发给文字模型。

「风格」或「复盘」页点「导入账号」，贴上自己的主页链接，支持小红书、抖音、B 站、TikTok、Instagram 和 X。读最近的公开内容和互动数据，进内容和复盘，顺便提炼成你的风格。再导入一次只更新数字。 第一次用要接 [Monid](https://monid.ai)，三步： 1. 把 `set up https://monid.ai/SKILL.md` 发给 DeepSeek Harness 的新会话，它会装好。 2. 到 [app.monid.ai](https://app.monid.ai/access/api-keys) 注册，创建密钥。 3. 在终端执行 `monid keys add -k 你的密钥 -l main`。密钥别发在聊天里。 插件只调用本机的 `monid` 命令，不碰密钥。

只能导入自己的账号吗？
是。链接会发给 Monid 和它的数据服务商，请确认符合你和平台的条款。只能读到公开内容：小红书和抖音读不到播放量，复盘会改按互动算；小红书正文约 100 字，抖音是文案，B 站大多只有标题，提炼出的风格可以再手动改。公众号、视频号、YouTube 暂时导入不了，可以照常排期，风格可以贴内容或公开链接来提炼。
能直接发布吗？
不能。各平台没有统一接口，复制脚本或保存文件夹后自己发。保存的文件夹默认在 `~/Documents/自媒体工作台/`，里面有脚本、分镜脚本、视频封面、配图和分镜图。
我的东西存在哪？
全在本机 `~/.dsh/media-desk/`，桌面版和网页版共用。没有云端，没有账号系统。

没有生图模型也能用吗？
能。脚本、标题、分镜文案照常，视频封面会用封面大字合成一张纯文字版。接上生图模型后，封面、配图和分镜图都会画出来。
这是 DeepSeek 做的吗？
不是，是社区插件。脚本由你在 DeepSeek Harness 里配置的模型生成，按你自己的账户计费。

我是 [蜗牛的科技笔记](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/5faedce8000000000101c8a3)，在小红书做科技内容，小红书号 `1097519508`。这个工作台是我自己每天用的：灵感记不住、成稿太慢、发完不知道效果，这三件事我都踩过，所以做成了这样。用得顺手或者不顺手，欢迎提 [Issue](https://github.com/woniuniuniu/dsh-media-desk/issues)，也欢迎来小红书找我聊。

- [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 团队，做了这套开放的插件系统，这个工作台才装得进去。
- [dsh-Go](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go)，这份 README 的图文排版参考了它。

```bash
npm install && npm test        # Host 逻辑测试
npm run watch                  # 监听 client/ 并重新打包
scripts/dev-sandbox.sh         # 在隔离的 DSH_HOME 里跑网页版，不碰 ~/.dsh
node scripts/mock-llm.mjs      # 模拟文字和生图模型，不花额度

`scripts/mock-monid.mjs` 是假的 `monid` 命令，内容全是编的，用来不花钱测导入流程：包成名为 `monid` 的可执行文件放到 `PATH` 最前面。

| 目录 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | `client/` | 界面：灵感墙、成稿、对话、内容、排期、复盘、风格、设置 | | `src/` | Host 接口、成稿流水线、提示词、生图、风格提炼、Monid 导入、本地存储 | | `scripts/` | 打包、沙盒、模拟模型、示例素材生成 | | `assets/` | 示例图片和视频，全部由 `scripts/gen-assets.py` 程序绘制 | | `docs/assets/` | 本页的展示图 | 改了 `src/` 要重启 DeepSeek Harness。 **安全：** 每个接口都经过 Host 鉴权；模型输出和读到的外部内容只取固定字段、限制长度，操作走白名单；粘贴的链接不能访问本机和内网；调用 `monid` 不经过 shell，账号 ID 只接受固定格式。漏洞请走 [Security Advisories](https://github.com/woniuniuniu/dsh-media-desk/security/advisories/new) 私下报告。

Media Desk

A DeepSeek Harness plugin. Capture an idea, and one click drafts the script, cover, images and storyboard.

Built by 蜗牛的科技笔记 (Snail's Tech Notes), a tech creator on RedNote, as the desk behind their own daily posts.

Install · What it costs · FAQ · 简体中文

Media Desk is a page in the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) sidebar. It opens on a wall of your ideas, one line each. Open one, click **Draft it**, and you get a spoken script, a title, a video cover, images and a six-frame storyboard. Ask for changes in the chat on the left and the draft updates on the right. Then drag the finished piece onto the calendar, publish it, and come back for the numbers.

There are five pages: **Ideas · Content · Schedule · Insights · Styles**. The interface is available in English and Chinese. By default it follows the DeepSeek Harness language, and you can lock it to either one in the plugin settings. When the interface is in English, scripts, titles and storyboards are written in English. The web version also works in a phone browser. It works with TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and X as well as Chinese platforms (RedNote, Douyin, Bilibili, WeChat).

Everything fills in together.

The layout appears as soon as you open an idea. The title, script, cover, images and six storyboard frames are generated in parallel and appear as each one is ready.

Ask for a change.

Try "make it clearer", "shoot frame 3 from above" or "bolder cover text". The draft updates as you watch, and every change can be undone.

Take it with you.

Edit the script in place, copy it, or save the whole piece (cover, images and frames) to one folder.

One line, one idea.

Text, links, images, videos and quotes all become cards. Spread them out on an infinite canvas, or switch to a feed sorted by date.

Related ideas come to you.

Type "agent" and press Enter. Your new idea is saved, and every earlier idea that mentions agents moves next to it, sorted by relevance.

An assistant on the side.

"Write up today's best idea", "What's coming up?", "From now on, keep titles under 10 words". Ask in a sentence and it's done.

One calendar for ideas and posts.

Each day you capture an idea gets a stamp, so you can see your streak. Drag a finished piece from the side list onto a day to schedule it.

Your next post is always pinned in the top right.

See what worked, and keep doing it.

Enter numbers by hand, paste a CSV, or import your own account. You'll see daily views, a breakdown by platform and your top pieces in one place.

Turn a suggestion into a writing rule with one click and it applies to everything you write next. Rules can be exported as a DeepSeek Harness skill.

Pick a voice.

Fifteen creator presets in eight categories: tech, travel and food, lifestyle, opinion, tutorials, reviews, stories and news. Pick one and start writing.

Or use your own.

Import your account or paste a few of your posts, and Media Desk learns your style into a card you can edit.

The content board shows where every piece stands: idea, outline, draft, ready or published.

Requires DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.5` or later in the `0.2.x` line. Tested on `0.2.2-rc.1`, desktop and web.

**1. Install.** In the DeepSeek Harness desktop app, go to Plugins → Add plugin, enter `dsh-media-desk`, and install.

You can also install from the command line. Quit the desktop app completely (⌘Q) first and reopen it afterwards. For the web version, restart `dsh web`. If the `dsh` command isn't available in your terminal, choose "Manage dsh command" from the desktop app's menu.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-media-desk
```

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-media-desk
```

**2. Update.** When a new version comes out, update it on the Plugins page or run the same command again. To install offline, download `dsh-media-desk-*.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/woniuniuniu/dsh-media-desk/releases/latest) and use `"file:$PWD/dsh-media-desk-VERSION.tgz"` in place of the package name.

**3. Open.** **Media Desk** appears in the sidebar. On first launch it's filled with sample data so you can explore every page. Click **Clear sample data** in the top right when you're ready to start with your own. To uninstall, replace `add` with `remove`. Your content stays in `~/.dsh/media-desk/`.
The plugin is free and ships with no API keys. Anything that uses a model runs on your own accounts.

| | What it uses | Without it |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Script** | The model you've set up in DeepSeek Harness | A structural outline only |
| **Cover, images, storyboard** | Your own image API key, added in the plugin settings | Script and storyboard text still work, and the cover is made from text |
| **Account import** (optional) | Monid, a third-party data service billed per request. Under a cent per TikTok, Instagram or X account; about $0.02 for RedNote | Enter numbers by hand, or paste posts to learn a style |

Images work with any service compatible with the OpenAI Images API (`POST {endpoint}/images/generations`). OpenAI, xAI, Volcengine Ark, Zhipu and SiliconFlow come pre-filled, or you can add a custom endpoint. Click **Generate test image** to check that it works. Each draft makes 9 images by default, and you can change that. Your key is stored only in the local `settings.json` (file mode 600). It never goes into your content data and is never sent to the text model.

In Styles or Insights, click **Import account** and paste your profile link. Supported: TikTok, Instagram, X, RedNote, Douyin and Bilibili. Your latest public posts and their engagement go into Content and Insights, and Media Desk learns your style from them. Importing again only refreshes the numbers.

The first time, connect [Monid](https://monid.ai) in three steps:

1. In a new DeepSeek Harness session, send `set up https://monid.ai/SKILL.md`. It installs the Monid command-line tool. 2. Sign up at [app.monid.ai](https://app.monid.ai/access/api-keys) and create an API key. 3. In your terminal, run `monid keys add -k YOUR_KEY -l main`. Don't paste the key into a chat. The plugin only runs the local `monid` command and never sees your key.

Can I import someone else's account?
Import only accounts you own. Profile links are sent to Monid and its data providers, so check that this fits your platform's terms. Only public data is available: RedNote and Douyin don't show view counts publicly, so Insights uses engagement instead. YouTube, WeChat and WeChat Channels can't be imported yet. You can still schedule posts for them, and paste content or public links to learn a style.

Can it post for me?
No. Platforms don't offer a common publishing API, so copy the script or save the folder and post it yourself. Saved folders go to `~/Documents/Media Desk/` by default and include the script, storyboard, cover, images and frames.
Where is my data?
Everything stays on your computer in `~/.dsh/media-desk/`, shared by the desktop and web versions. No cloud and no sign-up.

Does it work without an image model?
Yes. The script, title and storyboard text are written as usual, and the cover is made from the cover text. Connect an image model to draw the cover, images and frames too.
Is this made by DeepSeek?
No. It's a community plugin. Scripts are written by the model you've set up in DeepSeek Harness and billed to your own account.

I'm [蜗牛的科技笔记](https://www.xiaohongshu.com/user/profile/5faedce8000000000101c8a3) (Snail's Tech Notes), a tech creator on RedNote (ID `1097519508`). I use this desk every day. It's built around three problems I kept running into: losing ideas, drafts that took too long, and never checking how posts did. Issues and ideas are welcome on [GitHub](https://github.com/woniuniuniu/dsh-media-desk/issues).

- The [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) team, for an open plugin system to build on.
- [dsh-Go](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go), whose README layout inspired this one.

```bash
npm install && npm test        # host logic tests
npm run watch                  # rebuild when client/ changes
scripts/dev-sandbox.sh         # run the web version in an isolated DSH_HOME
node scripts/mock-llm.mjs      # mock text and image models, no quota used

`scripts/mock-monid.mjs` is a fake `monid` command that returns made-up content, so you can test the import flow for free. Wrap it as an executable named `monid` and put it first on your `PATH`.

| Path | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `client/` | UI: idea wall, studio, chat, content, schedule, insights, styles, settings |
| `src/` | Host routes, drafting pipeline, prompts, image generation, style learning, Monid import, local storage |
| `scripts/` | Bundling, sandbox, mock models, sample asset generation |
| `assets/` | Sample images and videos, all generated by `scripts/gen-assets.py` |
| `docs/assets/` | The images on this page |

Restart DeepSeek Harness after changing `src/`.

**Security:** Every route is authenticated by the host. Model output and fetched content are reduced to known fields with length limits, and only allow-listed operations run. Pasted links can't reach localhost or private networks. `monid` runs without a shell, and account IDs must match fixed formats. Please report vulnerabilities privately through [Security Advisories](https://github.com/woniuniuniu/dsh-media-desk/security/advisories/new).
